commit_message:
ANDROID: KVM: arm64: Prevent donation of non-memory regions to the guest

Commit d9eca052eb70 ("ANDROID: KVM: arm64: Drop pkvm_mem_transition for
host-to-guest donations") refactored the host-to-guest donation code but
inadvertently permitted the donation of non-memory regions. Although
this is necessary for assignment of devices, that is managed through the
'__pkvm_host_donate_hyp_mmio' hypercall and so the normal donation path
doesn't need to worry about it.

Remove support for non-memory regions from __pkvm_host_donate_guest()
and __pkvm_host_donate_sglist_guest().

Bug: 459479964
Fixes: d9eca052eb70 ("ANDROID: KVM: arm64: Drop pkvm_mem_transition for host-to-guest donations")
Change-Id: I8e4ae353e69e255311df3321dddd7ce516fbde8f
